t: This is the statue of Henry Bathurst at the Colonial Office, which both commemorates and depicts him. Bathurst, the third Earl Bathurst, was a Tory politician who sat as an MP for thirty years before he was made a peer. He was a personal friend of William Pitt the Younger, and during the Napoleonic era he brokered deals between factions in the cabinet. After the wars he stood on the conservative wing of the Tory party.
